items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: when we were there mostly Smiley and Joe, we had the quartet.

ctx.x: I just barely remember her myself sitting there. In fact, that was kind of a strange setup when you start to think about it now. The different intermission bands I had there.
Yeah. Well, when we were there mostly Smiley and Joe, we had the quartet.
And very different from Sharky. That was an entirely different sound.
